docs.title: Installation
docs.body:
Follow these steps to get the project running locally.

Requirements

  • Modern browser
  • Text editor
  • Optional local web server for faster development

Steps

  1. Clone or download the project folder.
  2. Open the folder in your preferred editor.
  3. Open index.html in a browser or serve the folder using a local server.

Usage

docs.title: Architecture
docs.body:
This section covers how the project is organized and how the main parts are connected.

Project layout

  • index.html — entry point for the project.
  • assets/css/ — primary styling files for pages, navigation, and components.
  • assets/js/ — interactive scripts and behavior logic.

Design approach

Keep content separate from styling and behavior so the project remains easy to maintain. Reuse shared assets, keep sections modular, and rely on simple HTML structure for flexibility.
